description.value:
You release a pulse of restorative biotic energy that pulls your whole squad back into the fight at once.

You and each ally within 30 feet regain Hit Points equal to 10% of their maximum Hit Points, and their kinetic shields recharge to full.

A creature at 0 Hit Points is revived: it loses the dying condition and wakes up with that healing and a full shield. It becomes wounded as it normally would. Unity cannot raise the dead and does not refill a Biotic Barrier.

Unity costs 1 Focus Point, which you regain when you Refocus. It has no cooldown.

Heightened (+2) The healing increases by 10% of maximum Hit Points: 20% at 5th level, 30% at 9th, 40% at 13th and 50% at 17th.

Improved Unity Each creature Unity reaches also loses Frightened, Sickened and Stunned 1.

Superior Unity A creature Unity revives does not become wounded (or more wounded) and stands up for free, and Unity ends persistent damage on each creature it reaches.

target.value: you and each ally in the area
